sample_unit: clinicians (attending physicians and advanced practice clinicians)
models_evaluated: hybrid ambient clinical documentation (LLM draft notes plus human virtual scribe)

links.outcome: After-hours work, documentation delay, and wRVU productivity after ambient scribe activation
links.effect: WOW rose 32.1% at day 10 then fell 41.7% by day 50; odds of delayed notes fell 66.0% at day 50; wRVUs rose 12.1% by day 50.
links.quote: ACD adoption was associated with reduced after-hours work, faster note completion, and improved financial productivity within 50 days of implementation.

links.outcome: Documentation time, after-hours work, and financial productivity after ambient scribe deployment
links.effect: WOW decreased 41.7% (95% CI -51.8%, -29.4%) by day 50; wRVUs increased 12.1% (95% CI 5.7%, 18.9%) by day 50.
links.quote: Financial productivity increased steadily by 1.5% (95% CI -0.2%, 3.2%) on day 10 and 12.1% (95% CI 5.7%, 18.9%) by day 50.

unlisted_practices: hybrid generative AI plus human virtual scribe review model for ambient documentation

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment of a hybrid ambient clinical documentation tool on clinician work outside of work, documentation delay, and productivity.
